verdict.rationale: Recurly Engage documents churn propensity modeling, a machine-learning feature that gives each subscriber a real-time 1–10 risk score to surface at-risk subscribers. That is an in-product, data-driven insight, but nothing shows broader AI-generated insights or suggested actions. The Compass MCP server lets external AI agents work with Recurly's tools and APIs, which is not an in-product insight capability, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, AI insights beyond churn risk (e.g., revenue or billing analytics), natural-language or assistant-style insight surfaces, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Churn propensity modeling is a machine learning feature in Recurly Engage that assigns each subscriber a real-time risk score from 1–10 to surface at-risk subscribers before they cancel.
